steps.name: The World Tree's Other Side
steps.objective: Go to the "Infinite Corridor" and talk to [Litania], then defeat [Dark Unicorns], [Dark Pegasi], and [Black Giselle] in the "Twisted World Tree".

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: You're here! This is urgent, so I'll get straight to the point.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: First, let me explain what kind of place this is...

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: This is the reverse world.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: It's known by many names: the shadow, the world beyond the mirror, the inner world, and so on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How strange. A reverse world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I had no idea it existed.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: That's understandable. Very few people know about it, and access is strictly controlled.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: If either side loses its balance, both worlds will suffer greatly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who controls access?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: On the Jiendia continent, a special agency reporting directly to the Empress handles it...

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Here at the Temple of Seres, we oversee Freios and several other regions.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: The temple is short-handed at the moment, so we've had to ask for your help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. So what exactly happened?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Something has distorted space and time, and demonic energy is pouring through the distortion.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Space and time? Demonic energy?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: The demon realm is filled with a deeply sinister energy.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: It can even alter the very nature of certain living beings.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: If this place becomes completely corrupted by it, the original World Tree will be in grave danger too.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Because both sides are in danger if either one loses its balance, like you said?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Exactly. In the end, they're the same place.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: I'll look for the cause. Please defeat the creatures that have been corrupted by the demonic energy.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: If we don't purify this place quickly, something terrible will happen.

steps.name: The Source of the Demonic Energy
steps.objective: Defeat [Dark Apprentice Mages] and [Red Apprentice Mages] in the "Twisted World Tree".

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: I've found the cause.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: A dark wizard's apprentices tried to summon a demon and failed. That's what caused this.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Summon a demon?

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Why? And why would they do something like that here, of all places...?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Dark wizards are enemies of us all.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: They bargain with dangerous beings from the demon realm, or from other worlds...

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Offering their souls as collateral for power, then using it to commit vile deeds.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: The temple and many other organizations keep a very close watch on them.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: They seem to have tried summoning a demon to gain even greater power, but...

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: I think they chose a very unfortunate time.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: An unfortunate time?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Demigod Belosh moved the World Tree to a new location, remember?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: That left the wizards who had sneaked inside with no way to return...

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: And their summoning ritual failed as well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Anyway, now that we know the cause, we can deal with it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do?

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Would you be willing to help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's something I can do, I'll help.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Then please use your skills to drive out the evil energy inside.

lines.speaker: %S
lines.text: Of course. I'll have that taken care of in no time.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: I'll leave the finishing touches to you. Hehe.

steps.name: Purification Begins
steps.objective: Talk to [Litania], then defeat the [Mutant Blue Dragon] in the "Twisted World Tree".

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: You've worked so hard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So have you, Litania.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Oh, all I did was a little purification. I hardly had to exert myself.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Ah, there's one more thing I'd like to ask...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Please keep the reverse world a secret.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Access to this world is strictly controlled...

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: And if too many people learn about it, the world will eventually fall into confusion.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: There are various other dangers as well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Anyway, thank you so much.

lines.speaker: 리타니아
lines.text: Leave the rest to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you need help, contact me anytime!
